screening_note: Unverified forum account, paraphrased by the team. Controller display fault; the post does not say what the aircraft did, so this is not confirmed link loss.
synopsis: Forum user reported the M4T controller screen briefly going blank in flight.
narrative: In October 2025 an M4T owner reported that the controller screen would suddenly go blank for one to two seconds and drop back to the main menu, sometimes showing a message in Chinese, in open fields with no obvious interference and on the latest firmware. The post does not describe what the aircraft did during these blackouts. Reinstalling firmware did not fix it.

screening_note: Unverified forum account, paraphrased by the team. A reply in the same thread; another reply said a later firmware update resolved a similar problem, with no root cause given.
synopsis: Second forum user reported an M4T controller freeze in flight that triggered return to home once.
narrative: In November 2025 a second M4T user in the same thread reported a similar controller freeze mid-flight. On the first occurrence the aircraft entered return to home. On two later flights the pilot flew it back manually. The user reflashed firmware and was collecting logs. A different reply said the next firmware update resolved their own similar issue.
